_comment: Canary fixture config — NOT the app's mutation config (that is /stryker.config.json). `break: 90` is deliberately unmeetable: src/calc.js's untested isEven leaves surviving mutants that hold the score far below 90, so the meta-test (scripts/stryker-break-canary.test.mjs) can assert a break violation really exits non-zero. Kept tiny (one file, one test, a handful of mutants) so the canary stays fast.
